station.name: Los Angeles – North Main Street
station.provider: South Coast Air Quality Management District / US EPA AirData
station.type: Single continuous FEM monitoring location; BAM-1020 with VSCC

periodBasis: UTC calendar year; fixed local standard time is available in the application

quality.seasonalEligibilityRule: At least 75% valid hourly readings in every UTC meteorological season
quality.missingTreatment: null; no interpolation, imputation, or substitution of a different monitor
quality.sourcePrecisionNote: Concentrations serialized to three decimal places
quality.spatialScope: One monitoring location; not a citywide or population-weighted exposure estimate
quality.sourceTimestamps: EPA Date GMT + Time GMT retained; checked against PST fixed local standard timestamp plus eight hours
quality.license: Public domain US EPA AQS monitoring data
quality.qaStatus: EPA annual hourly summary: Certified. The app excludes negative concentrations and retains informational event flags. South Coast AQMD requests that POC3 2025 not be compared to the NAAQS after failed comparability testing. Use these measured data for exploratory exposure comparisons, not an official regulatory assessment.
quality.selectionReason: Same site 06-037-1103, parameter 88101, POC 3, continuous FEM method 170 retained across years
quality.eventTreatment: Retain IH fireworks, IJ high winds, IT US wildfire and J construction observations, which EPA classifies as informational. Exclude negative reported concentrations under the application rule; original source rows remain in the research extract.
quality.regulatoryInterpretation: The July 2026 South Coast AQMD comparability appendix requests that this POC 3 2025 series not be compared to the NAAQS after its 2023–2025 bias assessment. It is retained for exploratory exposure comparison, not as an official regulatory design value.
quality.boundaryNote: EPA file indexed by local standard 2025; first eight UTC-year hours are not in this file and remain null. Genuine localYear is retained separately.

localYear.timeBasis: PST fixed local standard time, 2025 calendar year

timeConvention.hour_interval_semantics: EPA defines hourly timestamps as the beginning of sampling; local fields use fixed local standard time (PST, UTC−8).
timeConvention.utc_conversion: Use supplied Date GMT + Time GMT; every row checked against local timestamp plus 8 hours.
